correctness.rationale: For the full transitive strict order on finite product P=∏[m_i], rank ρ(x)=Σ x_i is recovered by successive predecessor-existence refinement, so by round H=Σ(m_i−1) all ranks are known. Already at round one, counts of strict predecessors and successors recover inclusive D(x)=∏(a_i+1), U(x)=∏(m_i−a_i). At round H+1, rank-adjacent strict predecessors and successors are exactly covers. D/U ratios for lower covers recover (a_i,b_i=m_i−1−a_i) for all a_i>0, while upper covers with recovered a_i=0 recover missing boundary coordinates with multiplicity. Thus the multiset of (m_i,a_i) is determined. A product-lattice automorphism permutes only equal-length chains of join-irreducibles, so recovered coordinate multisets equal precisely the orbits. Multiset combinatorics gives ∏_m binom(r_m+m−1,m−1) orbits and multinomial sizes. Boundary cases and non-equal factor lengths are included. Separate finite scripts inspect 112 configurations (9403 vertices) and 56 explicit automorphism checks, while an independently coded cover-ratio check covers (2,3,4),(2,2,2,3),(3,3,4),(2,2,2,2). These are supporting checks, not the proof for all d.
